metadata.description: Live-captured via bin/mock-capture against <internal-env>/26.2.0.0, org group 138883 (sdktest), the recapture epic's Group A retry. Resolves AppsV2Service.GetListOfDevices (operation AppsV2_GetListOfDevices) -- NOTE this is not a create/assign call despite sharing the POST verb and path with the assignment-rules resource: swagger declares it as a devices-preview query (required query param action=PREVIEW_DEVICES), taking an AppAssignmentRuleV2Model body to preview which devices would be added/removed/unchanged if that rule were applied, without persisting anything. Called against the same real internal iOS app used for the sibling GET/PUT assignment-rules captures (its own UUID as {applicationUuid}), with an empty {} body (no assignments configured). 200, real success: total_count 0 (no devices match an empty rule, expected). App deleted at session end; deletion confirmed.
